name: 르노어
motion_summary: Eternal Return Lenore Rhapsody of Agony: blue bob hair with long fringe over ONE eye exactly like reference, visible other eye and tiny mouth, refined black/blue musician outfit; plays a VIOLIN with a BOW, not guitar or staff. R launches a haunting wave which expands then ends in a frenzy-inducing finale. Exact 12 poses: violin held low; raise violin to shoulder; bow poised; start downbow; long energetic downbow with first violet-blue musical wave to right; lift bow; vigorous upbow and wave expands; body leans into another stroke; final sweeping bow and large contained blue-violet circular resonance; follow-through; lower bow as wave fades; initial stance. Real left hand on violin neck, right hand bows with distinct arm angles, torso sways. Subtle warped musical rings, no typography/notes as letters, no scenery. Maintain visible eye and mouth.
visual_review: 앞머리의 한쪽 눈 가림을 원본처럼 유지하고 다른 눈/입은 보입니다. 바이올린 활질 방향·팔 각도·몸 기울기가 달라지며 광시곡 공명이 전개됩니다.
